competing_explanation: The policy may have changed, or the 30-day window may apply to a different product category or be measured from purchase rather than delivery.
hypothesis_statement: H_J: The current policy provides a 30-day full-refund return window for standard items, measured from delivery or receipt.
refutation_criterion: Counterfactual evidence shows the current standard-item return window is not 30 days, is not a full refund, or applies only to non-standard items.
